title: Billing exceptions monitor
question: Which accounts were billed outside their expected range, and which exception do we clear first?
story: {open_n} exceptions are open with {exposure} billed outside the expected range.
questions: Which rule raised the most exceptions this month?
Which open exceptions are older than 30 days?

datasets.name: records
datasets.sql: SELECT o.record_key, o.entity_id, o.entity_label, o.priority_tier, o.`rank`, o.top_reasons, o.recommended_action, o.value, o.exception_rule, o.age_days, o.as_of_date, a.region, a.segment, a.channel FROM main.finance.billing_out AS o JOIN main.finance.accounts AS a ON a.account_id = o.entity_id WHERE o.is_current AND o.change_source <> 'delete'

datasets.name: signal
datasets.sql: SELECT s.series, s.period, s.value, s.expected, s.lower, s.upper, s.is_anomaly, s.rule, a.region, a.segment, a.channel FROM main.finance.billing_out__signal AS s JOIN main.finance.accounts AS a ON a.account_id = s.series

datasets.name: open_items
datasets.sql: SELECT o.exception_rule, o.age_days, CASE WHEN o.age_days <= 7 THEN '0-7 days' WHEN o.age_days <= 30 THEN '8-30 days' WHEN o.age_days <= 90 THEN '31-90 days' ELSE 'Over 90 days' END AS age_bucket, o.value, a.region, a.segment, a.channel FROM main.finance.billing_out AS o JOIN main.finance.accounts AS a ON a.account_id = o.entity_id WHERE o.is_current AND o.change_source <> 'delete'

kpis.label: Points outside the range
kpis.expression: SUM(CASE WHEN is_anomaly THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)

kpis.label: Open over 30 days
kpis.expression: SUM(CASE WHEN age_days > 30 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)

charts.title: Billed against contract, with the expected range
charts.hint: Expected and its range come from the contract and the shipped weight.
charts.so_what: Points outside the range are the exceptions in the queue below.

charts.title: Exceptions by rule
charts.hint: Open exceptions by the rule that raised them.
charts.so_what: Fix the top rule at its source and most of the queue clears.

charts.title: Age of the open exceptions
charts.hint: Open exceptions by days since they were raised.
charts.so_what: Clear the oldest first: they are the hardest to recover from the account.

records.title: Triage queue
records.hint: Open exceptions from the latest run, ranked by exposure.
records.label: entity_label
